description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for Orleans Stateless Worker grains, verifying behaviors related to worker activation limits, exception handling during construction, concurrent invocation handling, multi-silo deployment behavior, and interleaving capabilities. The tests utilize Xunit framework and focus on ensuring robustness and correctness of Stateless Worker functionalities.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to verify Orleans Stateless Worker behaviors such as activation limits, exception handling, concurrency, multi-silo deployment, and method interleaving.

classes.name: CallbackObserver
classes.description: A helper class implementing ICallbackGrainObserver to facilitate callback testing within the test suite.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerThrowExceptionConstructor
methods.description: Tests that exceptions during the construction of a stateless worker grain are properly thrown and contain the expected message and inner exception.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerActivationsPerSiloDoNotExceedMaxLocalWorkersCount
methods.description: Verifies that the number of local activations for a stateless worker respects the maximum limit per silo under concurrent requests.

methods.name: ManyConcurrentInvocationsOnActivationLimitedStatelessWorkerDoesNotFail
methods.description: Checks for system stability and lack of failures when many concurrent invocations are made on stateless workers with limited activations.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerFastActivationsDontFailInMultiSiloDeployment
methods.description: Ensures that rapid concurrent activations across silos do not cause forwarding failures (currently skipped).

methods.name: StatelessWorker_DoesNotThrow_IfMarkedWithMayInterleave
methods.description: Tests that methods marked with MayInterleave can process concurrently without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldNotInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedDoesntMatch
methods.description: Verifies that when the MayInterleave predicate returns false, calls are executed sequentially, maintaining turn-based concurrency.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedMatches
methods.description: Checks that concurrent execution is possible when the MayInterleave predicate returns true, allowing maximum parallelism.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Member of CallbackObserver: Signals the callback to indicate readiness or occurrence.

methods.name: OnCallback
methods.description: Member of CallbackObserver: An async task representing the callback invocation.
